sections.h2: What CAN bus software development covers here
paras: CAN bus software development is writing the code that lets the controllers inside one machine exchange short, prioritised messages over a shared two-wire bus. Elevate Aura writes that code on the nodes: what each controller publishes, what it listens for, how often, and what it does when a message it depends on stops arriving.

Arbitration on CAN is decided by message identifier, so the identifier plan is a design decision rather than an afterthought. We agree the message set and identifier priorities with your team, implement them on your controllers in C/C++ or MicroPython, and test the behaviour on your hardware under load and under fault.

Where the data has to leave the machine, we also write the bridge: a node or small gateway that filters the traffic worth keeping and forwards it to a companion app or a telemetry pipeline. The transceivers, wiring, termination and the boards themselves stay with your hardware team. This is a software-only engagement.

sections.h2: Every board works alone. Together they argue.
sections.lead: CAN faults rarely look like software faults, which is why they are usually found late and on a live machine.

items.p: Priorities were never planned, so a chatty status message delays the one that had to be on time.

sections.h2: Getting CAN software written, three ways.

items.q: Do you define the message set or work from ours?
items.a: Either. If your team has a message and identifier plan we implement it as written. If not, we define it with you: which node sends what, payload layout and scaling, send rates and identifier priorities, and we document it for your own engineers and integrators.

items.q: Which controllers and languages do you use?
items.a: C or C++ on most production controllers, and MicroPython where the board supports it and the timing allows. We work to the chip and toolchain your hardware team has already chosen rather than asking you to move to something we prefer.

items.q: Can CAN data reach a phone or a dashboard?
items.a: Yes. A bridge filters the frames worth keeping and forwards them onward, over BLE or Wi-Fi to an app or into a pipeline on Supabase or Azure. See device-to-cloud telemetry software.

items.q: Do you supply transceivers or wire the bus?
items.a: No. Elevate Aura is software-only. Transceivers, isolation, termination, cable runs and the boards themselves are your hardware team's work. We write the software that runs on what you provide and test it on your hardware.

items.q: What about Modbus or serial links?
items.a: Also covered. See Modbus software development for RTU and TCP, and embedded software development for UART and other serial links.
